item.title: Jenkins on Arch Linux (i3): Install, Run, and Create Your First Project
item.description:
Jenkins on Arch Linux (i3)

This guide shows you how to:

  • Install Jenkins on Arch Linux (i3 window manager is fine)
  • Start and use Jenkins
  • Create a simple freestyle job
  • Create a real Jenkins Pipeline from a GitHub repo

The language is simple and the examples are small and realistic.

1. What is Jenkins? (Simple Explanation)

Jenkins is an automation server.

You can tell Jenkins to:

  • Get your code (for example from GitHub)
  • Run commands (build, test, scripts)
  • Show you if things passed or failed

Instead of you running commands manually every time, Jenkins does it automatically.
